translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Ikenkithatakoitziro kinankawo eejatzi kaariperori pinkathari
Ari roshiyakaawentanakero Jesús ompoñaantyaarime ramanaityaarime kiteesheriki, eero ripakagaitantawo.
Ikantzi: “Eenitatsi nampitsi, ari risaikiri kaariperori pinkathari, te ipinkathatziri Pawa, te ipinkathatzitari eejatzi atziri.
Ari isaikitari tsinane kinankawo. Ipokashitakeri kaariperori pinkathari, okantziri: ‘Nokowi pinkaimenari kisaneentanari, piwetsikainawo awishimotanari.’
Te ikowaweta pinkathari. Irojatzi ikantashiretantakari: ‘Te nompinkathateri Pawa, eejatzi atziri.
Iro kantacha jiroka kinankawo, ontzimatye nanteniro okowiri. Nisamawokari arika oomerencheena ipiyapiyatashitena.’ ”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Piñaakero ikantashiretakeri kaariperori pinkathari.
Iri maperotzirori Pawa, te rishenkaantzi rantainiri kameetha rashiyetaari, kamaitanaawori ramanaiyaari kiteesheriki.”
Eekero ikantatzi Jesús: “Eero rishenkagaita rantantaityaawori kameethari. Iro kantacha arika ripiyapaake Itomi Atziri, ¿eekeroma iñaapaatye awentaapiintaariri kipatsiki?”
Roshiyakaawentaitziri Fariseo eejatzi apatotziriri koriki
Eeniyetatsi kenkithashiretachari kameethashireri rinatzi. Irojatzi imanintashirewaitantariri itsipa atziri. Irojatzi roshiyakaawentantanakanariri Jesús, ikantzi:
“Eenitatsi apite atziri jatake tasorentsipankoki ramaña. Fariseo rinatzi apaani, iriima itsipa apatotziriri koriki.
Ikanta ikatziyapaaka Fariseo ramana, ikantzi: ‘Ariwé Pawa, tema te noshiyari naaka itsipa atziri, koshintzi rinatzi, kaariperoshireri ikanta, mayempiri rinatzi, ari roshiyari apatotziriri koriki.
Apite nitzitapiintawo awisayetzira kiteesheri rimakoryaantaitari, nowapiintzi koriki ikaatzi ripinaitanari.’
Ikanta apatotziriri koriki, ikatziyapaaka jantyaatsikaini, oiyotapaaka ramana te ramini jenoki. Tema rowashiretakoshiryaanakitya, ikantzi: ‘Pawa, pinkaminthagaina naaka, kaariperoshireri ninatzi.’ ”

Ikantanake Jesús: “Iriitake raakameethaiteri jirika, kameethashire riyaatai ipankoki, te roshiyari itsipa. Tema ikaatzi iriiperowaiwetachari iroñaaka, ari intsinampashiretakagaitairi. Iriima ikaatzi tsinampashirewaitatsiri iroñaaka, aritake iñagairo ririiperotakagaitairi.”
Ritasonkawentziri Jesús eentsipaini
Ikanta ramaitapaakeniri Jesús eenchaaniki, ikowaitzi riterotantyaari rako. Iri kantacha riyotaanewo Jesús, ikisathatawakeri amayetziriri eentsi.
Irojatzi ikantantanakari Jesús: “Pishineteri eenchaaniki ripokashitena. Eero pithañaana. Tema inkaate oshiyaarine eentsi, iriitake ñaagairone ipinkathariwentantaira Pawa.
Imaperotatya, eerorika ipinkathaitziri Pawa roshiyakotaityaari ikantaga eentsi, eero iñagairo impinkatharitai.”
Mainari ashaagantzinkari pinkatharitatsiri
Ikanta apaani pinkathari rosampitakeri Jesús, ikantziri: “Kameethari Yotaantanerí, ¿oitaka nantairi noñaantaiyaawori kantaitaachane añaamentotsi?”
Irojatzi rakantanakari Jesús, ikantzi: “¿Oitaka pikantantanari: ‘kameethari pinatzi?’ Apatziro ikantakaawo Pawa ikameethatzi, tekaatsi itsipa.
Piyotakotakeroma Inintakaantaitanewo, kantatsiri:
Ari rakanake mainari, ikantzi: “Yotaantanerí, nithotyaakero maawoini netanakawo pairani eeniro neentsitzi.”
Ikanta ikemakerira, ikantanakeri Jesús: “Tzimatsi kowapainchari panteri. Pimpimantero okaatzi pashitari, pimpashityaari ashironkaachari. Tema ari piñagairo pinintagaiya inkiteki. Pipoke, poyaatena.”
Ikanta ikemawake, owashire ikantanaka, tema ashaagantzinkari rinatzi.
Tema iñaakeri Jesús antawoite rowashiretanaka, ikantanake: “¡Imapero opomeentsita riyaatai ashaagantzinkari tsika ipinkatharitzi Pawa!
Tema eero okanta inkye piratsi camello imooki akoshi, iriitake maperotzirori impomeentsitya inkye ashaagantzinkari tsika ipinkatharitzi Pawa.”
Ikantayetanake ikaatzi kemakeriri Jesús: “¿Iitakama awisakoshiretaatsine?”
Irojatzi ikantantanakari Jesús: “Eenitatsi pomeentsitzimotariri atziri, iriima Pawa tekaatsi pomeentsitzimotyaarine.”
Ari ikantanake Pedro: “Jirika nokaataiyakenika naaka, nookayetanakero tzimimoyetanari, noyaataiyakemini.”
Ikantanake Jesús: “Imaperotatya, tzimatsirika kowanairori impinkathariwentairi Pawa, irootake rookantanakawori ipanko, ashitariri, irirentzi, iina, eejatzi rowaiyanepaini,
tema osheki raakotakeri iwairo Pawa jirika, aritake anagairo okaatzi rookanakeri. Ari inkantaityaari eejatzi paata arika iñagairo kantaitaachane añaamentotsi.”
Rapiitairo Jesús ithawetakota rowamagaiteri
Ikanta Jesús rapatotairi 12 riyotaanewo, ikantziri: “Aatatye iroñaaka Jerusalén-ki. Ari imonkaatyaari awishimoterine Itomi Atziri, tema irootake rosankenatakotakeri pairani Kamantantaneri.
Ari raakaantaiteri, rayeri atziri kaari asheninkata. Antawoite ishirontaminthaityaari, inkemaatsitakagaityaari, reewawootaiteri.
Arika onkaatake ripasawaitaiteri, ari rowamagaiteri. Iro awisawetakya mawa kiteesheri, ari rañagai eejatzi.”
Iro kantzimaitacha, te ikemathatziro jirikapaini ikaatzi kemawetainchari, tema te ikowaitzi inkemathatakagaiteri.
Raminakagaitairi Jericó-satzi
Ikanta Jesús areetzimataka nampitsiki Jericó. Ari risaiki mawityaakiri awotsinampiki ikowakotantzi impashitaityaari.
Ikemake mawityaakiri, rosampitakeri awisayetatsiri atziri, ikantziri: “¿Iitaka pokatsiri?”
Ikantaitanakeri: “Ripokatzi Jesús, iitaitziri Nazaret-satzi.”
Irojatzi ikaimantanakari, ikantzi: “¡Jesús, icharinetari David-ni, pineshironkataina naaka!”
Osheki ikisathaweetanakari imairetantyaari. Eekero ikaimanakitzi shintsiini, ikantzi: “¡Icharinetari David-ni, pineshironkataina naaka!”
Ari ikatziyapaaka Jesús, ikantzi: “Pamakenari jaka.” Ikanta ramaitapaakeniri, rosampitawakeri.
Ikantziri: “¿Oitaka pikowiri nantaimiri?” Rakanake mawityaakiri, ikantzi: “Nokowi nokiryagai, Pinkatharí.”
Ikantanake Jesús: “Aritake pokiryagai, iro etsiyatakotakagaimiri pawentagaana.”
Romapokashitanaka raminanai, royaatanakeri Jesús, kimoshire ikantawentanakari Pawa. Ikanta atziripaini iñaakero rantakeri Jesús, rimatanakero iriroripaini ithaamentawentanakari Pawa.

footnotes.text: Kantakotachari jaka “rowashiretakoshiryaanakitya”, irootake kantakotachari romposashipaneetanakitya atziri. Tema irootake rameyetari Judá-ite arika rowashiretakoshiretyaawo oitarika. Inashita ametari aakapaini arika omposashipaneetya, tema asagaawentawaitatya.
